Technique for collection, loading and handling means for biodegradable waste (allowance 3/3)

Material recovery of waste - recycling technologies (food, canning, viticulture) (allowance 2/2)
Trends in waste management, closed cycle technology, BAT technology (allowance 2/2)
Principles for preparing a waste management plan (allowance 2/2)

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: To acquaint students with the issues of BRO processing from the field of horticulture from the point of view of applied technologies (e.g. composting, bioenergy) and technical means used.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Types of waste from agriculture and food industry, classification of waste, principles of waste management, waste management plan (allowance 2/2)2.Horticultural wastes, classification and characteristics of the most common biodegradable waste (allowance 2/2)3.Waste collection and collection systems, separate collection, collection containers (allowance 1/1)4.Technique for collection, loading and handling means for biodegradable waste (allowance 3/3)5.The use of logistic methods in the design and optimization of the waste collection system (allowance 3/3)6.Mechanical - physical treatment of waste and used technology (sorting, crushing, pressing) (allowance 1/1)7.Composting technology, biodegradable waste composting (allowance 4/4)8.Technology for use of biodegradable waste for energy purposes (allowance 2/2)9.Biogas transformations, biodegradable waste processing for biogas production, principles, biogas plant operation (allowance 2/2)10.Technologies applied to WWTP, principles, operation characteristics (allowance 2/2)11.Material recovery of waste - recycling technologies (food, canning, viticulture) (allowance 2/2)12.Trends in waste management, closed cycle technology, BAT technology (allowance 2/2)13.Principles for preparing a waste management plan (allowance 2/2)
